findings.title: Anonymous FTP login accepted
findings.impact: Anonymous access can expose published directory information; file access depends on permissions.
findings.remediation: Disable anonymous access unless intentional; otherwise isolate public data and restrict permissions.
findings.limitations: Plain FTP only. One anonymous identity and the login directory are tested. No file read, write, or FTPS audit.

findings.impact: Unauthenticated directory access exposes names and metadata in the tested share.
findings.remediation: Restrict guest access and review both share and filesystem permissions.
findings.limitations: Signing evidence concerns negotiated dialects only. Empty credentials may map to Guest. Share tests use SMB2/3 and at most five share roots; file read/write and exploitation are not tested.

findings.title: Unsigned DNS zone transfer accepted
findings.impact: The tested source can obtain zone records, potentially revealing infrastructure names and addresses.
findings.remediation: Restrict zone transfers to intended secondary servers and use TSIG where appropriate.
findings.limitations: Only the supplied zone and this scanner's source are tested. Source-IP authorization may be intentional. No subdomains or additional targets are followed; capped or incomplete transfers are inconclusive.

findings.title: SNMPv2c read access accepted
findings.impact: Community-based SNMP exposes the requested system description without encrypted transport.
findings.remediation: Prefer SNMPv3 authPriv, restrict management sources, and replace default community strings.
findings.limitations: One community and one read-only OID are tested. No response is inconclusive; write access, other communities, other OIDs, SNMPv1, and SNMPv3 configuration are not assessed.

findings.title: Legacy SSH key exchange offered
findings.impact: Legacy algorithms remain available to clients; actual session selection depends on negotiation.
findings.remediation: Remove the listed algorithms after testing client compatibility; keep the SSH implementation updated.
findings.limitations: Only offered algorithm names are checked against the documented project policy. No authentication or root-login setting is inferred. ssh-rsa denotes SHA-1 signatures, not every RSA key.
